verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's first-party HyperAgent framework accepts natural-language commands through `page.ai()` and `page.extract()`, and its Extract API takes a prompt. These are the product's own natural-language interfaces, but they sit inside code (SDK or Playwright calls) and drive browser actions, not the platform as a whole. Missing for 10: a documented natural-language interface for operating the platform itself (sessions, profiles, recordings, settings) without writing code, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language commands work reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Write natural language commands instead of complex selectors
await page.ai("search for flights from Miami to LAX, select the cheapest option");
Define what you want using natural language and optionally enforce a schema with Zod for type-safe results.
You can define a schema and prompt, and Hyperbrowser will extract the data matching your requirements.
